Precinct and Polling Places

Select a county and click on "View Results' to obtain a list of polling places and precincts. Note that a temporary polling place used for a specific election will not appear on this list. Polling places can change for a variety of reasons. Always be sure to check your MyscVOTES to find your voting location before leaving to vote.
